svg.title: Approval block: signed and stamped APPROVED
svg.desc: End of the drawing set. An approval table lists drawn by Suriyaprakash Palanisamy, checked with PyTest coverage above 85% and 87 XCTest tests, and a signature that writes itself; a red APPROVED rubber stamp slams onto the sheet. Contact tags follow below the image.

g.text: Contact tags are below this sheet. ↓
